limitations: This is a compact projection of saved development runs; full raw records are required to rerun verification.
No simulation, model, external notification or hardware execution is started by this reducer.
A verifier-only recheck is a new offline assessment of the original immutable HTTP run, not a new flight or a replacement of its signed verdict.
Requests retain candidate hashes and presented constraints, not full navigation observations; independent admission is repeated at the recorded later observation, not reconstructed at request time.
Timing deltas are simulator seconds. Provider latency is separately recorded in receipt milliseconds.
Missing submitted responses may hide late provider calls; receipt counts are not automatically total billing counts.
Recovery service completion intervals are forecasts only; actual servicing and recovery are not simulated or observed.
Engineering target areas, waiting-resource assumptions, four forecast checks and two fixed opportunities do not establish real ocean clearance, numerical convergence or SpaceX accuracy.
Matching fallback outcomes do not invalidate executed AI control, and outcome divergence alone does not prove AI superiority.

prior_evidence.role: Preserved old runs, including scripted next-orbit counterfactual; not current runtime or a further live attempt.
